|lore=Controlled by state-of-the-art voice-activated X10-D computers. Internal sensors and security systems monitor prisoner activity. Modified for Bossk’s Trandoshan physiology.
|game_text=May add 1 alien pilot, 6 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Deploys (even using Combat Response) and moves like a starfighter. While Bossk piloting, adds one battle destiny and immune to attrition < 4.

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The original title omits the apostrophe. The later slip adds a vehicle slot and fixes Bossk’s attrition immunity at less than 4. It drops the Bossk power bonus and the ship-docking clause. Both keep the original subtype, matching Bossk battle destiny, and starfighter movement. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=85 Period ship-docking capability].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards5.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #49 on 14 September 2007); page 4, slip 39. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Hound's Tooth]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time#Cards|Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
